purpose.summary: This program manages inventory 'partidas' (stock lots/batches) for articles in a multi-company, multi-branch system. It provides interactive screen-based CRUD operations (alta/baja/modificación — add/delete/modify) for stock lot records including pricing, cost, internal tax, stock balance, and warehouse position data. It also supports printing reports of articles by brand.
purpose.domain: inventory/wholesale distribution (likely Argentine retail/wholesale goods management)

verdict.notes: File is truncated at 16000 chars out of 43264 bytes; the full program is ~1111 lines. The heavy use of COPY for all file definitions and error handlers, combined with PC-XT-AT target, COMP-4, and Argentine Spanish field names/comments, strongly suggests a 1990-era Argentine business application written in RM/COBOL or Micro Focus COBOL for DOS. The DECLARATIVES section uses COPY for error handlers, which is a common Micro Focus pattern. The program name PARTI and author ALVARO GUIFFREY are consistent with Argentine provenance.
